newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's seismic oil survey shows promising areas.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's seismic oil survey shows promising areas.

text.p: State-owned Kuwait Oil Co (KOC) said on Monday results of a seismic survey show that an area south of Kuwait City has encouraging oil potential, the official Kuwait News Agency reported.
The survey shows "that in the Umm al-Haiman area there are areas with encouraging oil potential," the agency reported a KOC official as saying. He did not give details.
Sixty-five percent of the $130-million seismic survey has been completed, it said.
"The purpose of the project is to increase oil and gas reserves," the official said.
Kuwait seeks to boost its production capacity to 3.5 million barrels per day (bpd) in 2005 from a current capacity of about 2.5 million bpd.
OPEC-member Kuwait produces around two million bpd. Kuwait has one tenth of the world's proven oil reserves.
The study covers several residential and other areas including parts of the coastal strip in Kuwait which depends on oil for about 90 percent of its state income.
